blocks: Recorded November 23, 2026 with the Microfreak and Novation/Launchpad/Pro/Mk3, from the GitP/A/Template/LPP Seq template. The Ableton/Live 12.4.16 set runs at 58.39 BPM. GitP/A/Log/26/11/23-Mon

The episode is mixed from the template's four recording tracks, soloed together, so the volume, pan and send moves of the performance are in it. In the Arrangement, four passages were cut: 33 seconds at 02:59, 29 seconds at 04:15, 23 seconds at 05:12 and 73 seconds at 06:49.
No commentary announces the presets. GitP/A/Log/26/11/23-Mon names them in the order they were used, and each chapter starts where a new take first carries that sound.
Microfreak/Preset/244 Nebem · A SawX oscillator through a low-pass filter. Download the saved slot 244 capture
Microfreak/Preset/245 GivemeSub · The Harm oscillator through a nearly closed low-pass filter that the Cycling Envelope opens. Download the saved slot 245 capture
Microfreak/Preset/247 Laity · A paraphonic SawX lead whose filter cutoff and resonance rise with expression. Download the saved slot 247 capture
Microfreak/Preset/248 GrowLing · A SawX oscillator through a band-pass filter, with the Cycling Envelope sweeping Wave. Download the saved slot 248 capture
9:48 stereo MP3 at 192 kbps and 44.1 kHz, encoded from the 24-bit, 48 kHz Ableton Live export. The export ran to 10:23; the last 35 seconds were digital silence and are trimmed.

Standard MIDI file with a tempo track at 58.39 BPM and two Arrangement tracks. The first carries the notes recorded on the third Launchpad/Sequencer track, on MIDI channel 3. The second carries the MicroFreak's own output on channel 1: notes played on its keyboard and its knob movements.

Clip positions and trims follow the edited Ableton Live arrangement, so the file lines up with the episode recording from its first beat. The other sequencer tracks recorded no notes in the Arrangement.
In this Knowledge Garden, Launchpad means the Novation Launchpad Pro Mk3. Other Launchpad models belong under the Novation/Launchpad namespace.
User guide for the Launchpad, the Novation Launchpad Pro Mk3 grid controller.
Launchpad Pro is a grid controller for producing and performing with Ableton Live or external MIDI hardware.
Its 64 velocity- and pressure-sensitive RGB pads can launch clips, play notes, and sequence steps. The four-track, 32-step sequencer provides probability and mutation controls for evolving patterns.
Eight Custom Modes can send MIDI to software or hardware. The two MIDI output ports extend control to external instruments.
The unit can operate without a computer when powered through its USB-C port by the included wall adapter.
Ableton Live integration: play, record, and produce from the controller.
Pads: 64 RGB pads sense velocity and pressure.
Sequencer: four tracks with 32-step patterns, scenes, probability, and mutation.
Chord Mode: explore, build, save, and play chords from the grid.
Note and Scale Modes: play melodies and chords in key; Drum Mode maps a drum rack to the grid.
MIDI connections: MIDI In, Out 1, and Out 2/Thru connect external equipment.
Custom Modes: eight editable MIDI layouts made with Novation Components.
